title: Harmonized U.S. Fetal Death Microdata, 1992-2022
description:
A modern, researcher-ready release of harmonized U.S. fetal death microdata for cross-year stillbirth research. Spans 29 years (1992-2022, with 2003-2004 deferred to V2.1) of NCHS public-use fetal death files reconciled into a single Parquet file with one stable schema.

Scope. 1,634,195 total records across 29 years (V2 era 1992-2002: 700,704 rows, all 1989 revision; V1 era 2005-2022: 933,491 rows, 2003-revision transition). 73 harmonized variables in the base file plus 16 derived analytic variables (89 columns total) in the derived file. 727,155 records form the standard NVSR-comparable subset (tabulation_flag == '2' AND residence_status != '4').

Cross-era V2 code-system fixes. 5 V2 value-level normalizations (B1 fetal_sex, B2 delivery_method_recode, B3 maternal_race_bridged, B4 paternal_age_recode11, B6 delivery_place_recode). 3 within_era columns (B5 breech_unrevised, delivery_place_unrevised, maternal_race_bridged_detail) where the underlying concepts/categories are fundamentally incompatible across eras and cross-era groupby is unsafe. 1 partial relabel (maternal_age, downgraded full → partial because V2 1989-rev DMAGE is exact single-year while V1 MAGER top/bottom-codes 50+/12-).

Validation. 74 checks against published NCHS/NVSR statistics (55 V1 + 19 V2): 68 byte-exact matches plus 6 documented differences in V1 detail-cell tabulations (4 early/late gestational-age cells where NVSR proportionally redistributes records with unknown gestational age; 2 cause-of-death cells where NVSR Table 8 restricts to a 43-state reporting area while the harmonization includes all states). All per-year fetal death counts (29 of 29 years) and all per-year fetal mortality rates (26 of 26 years) match the published figures exactly.

Companion product. For demographic-stratified live-birth denominators (race-, age-, or ethnicity-specific) needed to compute fetal mortality rates, see the U.S. Natality Harmonization Project (Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19363074).
